Meta.title: Mateus Winter — Full-stack Developer
Meta.description: Full-stack developer with a front-end and UI/UX focus. I build web and mobile products in React, Next.js, React Native and Laravel — tested end to end.

Hero.intro: I build web and mobile products end to end in React, Next.js, React Native and Laravel — polished on the surface, tested underneath.
Hero.stackSr: Stack: Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, React Native, Laravel/Node.js, Figma and Git.

About.label: About me
About.lead: I'm Mateus, a full-stack developer & UI/UX designer. For over five years, I've been turning complex products into uncomplicated interfaces.
About.body: I started out building websites, moved into front-end and UI/UX, and today I work across the whole stack: React and Next.js, React Native and Expo, Laravel and PostgreSQL. I care about the details users notice — and the ones they never should: loading states, accessibility, a map that doesn't stutter.
About.ai: With Claude Code in my daily work, my job has become more engineering and less typing: I design the architecture, anticipate the edge cases, review every diff and validate everything with tests.
About.photoAlt: Portrait of Mateus Winter smiling, wearing glasses and a dark suit

Work.title: Selected work

grao-co.summary: A specialty-coffee store with a Laravel API, a Next.js backend-for-frontend and 196 automated tests.

steps.title: Plan
steps.body: I start from the problem, not the tool: the flows, the edge cases and the hard states — empty, loading, error. With a Figma file, a design system or just a ticket, I know what I'm building before I write a line of code.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: TypeScript, Next.js and React Native on the front, Laravel on the back. One branch per feature, small pull requests, readable commits.

steps.title: Test
steps.body: Jest and Testing Library for units, Playwright for real user flows, PHPUnit on the API. When a bug shows up, a test comes with the fix.

steps.title: Ship
steps.body: Every diff reviewed — mine and the AI's — then deployed: Vercel for the web, TestFlight and Firebase for mobile.

items.title: Front-end

items.title: Back-end
items.body: Laravel and PostgreSQL APIs: Sanctum auth, validation, rate limiting that understands the architecture, and feature tests.

items.title: UI/UX
items.body: An eye for interfaces: I implement designs faithfully and question what hurts usability — and when there's no designer, I can map the flows and design the screens myself.

myfleet.summary: Dashboards, real-time maps, trip history, telemetry charts and reports shipped to 5 white-label platforms. React Native manager and driver apps with push notifications. Laravel and PostgreSQL on the back-end since 2026.

ai.summary: Claude Code is part of my daily workflow on MyFleet: I plan each task with it, carry one change across 5 white-label fronts, 2 mobile apps and the Laravel API, and review every diff before it becomes a PR. I also build tooling on top of it — a skill that ships the weekly test builds to TestFlight and Firebase, the sprint backlog read from Notion over MCP, hooks, and a project memory of lessons learned.
